purpose: Declare the first fixed-CI/correlated implementation family and convergence-lock policy before any accepted operator review.

model_family_declaration.family_label: correlated antisymmetrized two-electron variational / CI-family residual operator
model_family_declaration.review_target_reference_family: Hylleraas-CI or comparably correlated two-electron basis family
model_family_declaration.ground_state_reference_anchor: E-Hy-CI ground-state reference is used only as an external correlated anchor, not as proof that the repo implementation exists

convergence_policy_declaration.basis_lock_rule: The exact basis family, truncation rule, and basis-size schedule must be written before any selected holdout or CHIANTI rows are evaluated.
minimum_review_requirements: declared basis-size or staged convergence schedule
declared stopping criterion or residual-change criterion
convergence_policy_declaration.holdout_lock_rule: No selected holdout or CHIANTI row may change basis-size, truncation, or convergence settings after declaration.

blocked_claims: declaring a CI-family means the operator is implemented
declaring a convergence policy means residual rows are accepted operator output
external correlated reference anchors can substitute for an in-repo accepted operator
claim_boundary: This declaration records the intended fixed-CI family and convergence-lock policy only. It does not implement, accept, or validate a correlated two-electron operator.
